review_notes: I read the whole 73-line file. It introduces no new definitions or structures. It has one theorem, `UniformConvergenceCLM.locallyConvexSpace`, which proves local convexity of the strong topology for a directed family 𝔖. It also has one instance, `ContinuousLinearMap.instLocallyConvexSpace`, which specialises that theorem to von Neumann bounded sets. The instance is a named specialisation of the general theorem, not a competing version of an existing concept. I did not run searches of the related roots, because no definition here could duplicate an existing concept. The only residual uncertainty is that I did not check whether the instance duplicates another instance elsewhere in Mathlib. Standalone theorem duplication is excluded by the rubric anyway.
